questions.subject: CALCULUS_II
questions.learningObjective: Explain how tangent vectors produce an area element.
questions.stem: The tangent table explains how a parallelogram built on two tangent vectors becomes an area element. Give that explanation.

answer.exemplar: Each small patch of a parameterised surface is spanned by two tangent vectors, one for each parameter direction. The parallelogram they build has area equal to the length of their cross product, so that length multiplied by du dv is the true area of the patch. Summing these elements over the parameter domain gives the total surface area.

questions.explanation: The area element is the cross product of the two tangent vectors times du dv, since the parallelogram they span approximates a small patch. Integrating it gives the total area.
questions.hint: A small patch is spanned by two tangents.
